'''''Mandevilla splendens''''', the '''shining mandevilla''', is a [[species]] of [[flowering plant]] in the [[family (botany)|family]] [[Apocynaceae]]. It is an evergreen [[vine]], native to [[Brazil]].<ref name="Botanica 563">"Botanica. The Illustrated AZ of over 10000 garden plants and how to cultivate them", p. 563. Könemann, 2004. {{ISBN|3-8331-1253-0}}</ref>

It climbs by twining and can grow to {{convert|3 |m|ft|abbr=on}} high. It has wide green glossy leaves of elliptical or rectangular shape growing to {{convert| 20|cm|in|abbr=on}} long. The flowers are rose-pink with yellow centers, appearing from late spring to early summer. They are up to {{convert|10 |cm|in|abbr=on}} in length. It prefers temperatures remaining over {{convert|5-10 |C|F|abbr=on}}.<ref name="Botanica 563"/> In [[temperate climate|temperate]] zones it can be placed outside during the summer months, but must have protection in winter. It requires a sheltered spot in full sun. It has gained the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]].<ref name = RHSPF>{{cite web | url= https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/81610/i-Mandevilla-splendens-i/Details
| title = RHS Plantfinder - ''Mandevilla splendens'' | accessdate=4 April 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite web  
| url= https://www.rhs.org.uk/plants/pdfs/agm-lists/agm-ornamentals.pdf | title = AGM Plants - Ornamental | date = July 2017
